physical_check: Measure pitch at five points per axis and both diagonal flatness readings, recording gauge uncertainty.

physical_check: Fit both board thicknesses and measure angular creep after 30 minutes under the maximum eccentric load.

engineering_result: Digital engineering screen. Raise the tilt pivot to clear the camera sweep.
physical_check: Sweep 250 reversals with the specified dummy module and cable, measuring clearance and return angle.

engineering_result: Digital engineering screen. Reduce trigger travel until a center press registers.

engineering_result: Digital engineering screen. Keep both bolt washers clear of the bumper pad.

product: Vacuum picking head for a teaching arm
engineering_result: Digital engineering screen. Size the suction cup for a nonporous coupon.
physical_check: Perform 100 lifts of a 50 g coupon in a contained bin and measure release delay, leakage and power-loss response.

engineering_result: A 25.2° steering setting gives a 309.73 mm modeled turning radius and 15.90 mm support reserve.
physical_check: Measure real wheel contact and loaded center of mass. Check curves, wheel scrub, floor transitions, steering play and frame vibration with a noncritical payload.

engineering_result: Increasing the nominal cable-path radius to 23 mm leaves 20.4 mm on the largest cable's inside surface and retains 0.20–0.60 mm modeled pad interference.
physical_check: Measure the actual cage threads, cable diameter, manufacturer bend requirement and connectors. Use a pull gauge to verify that force reaches the cage and the padding leaves the cable and ports undamaged.

engineering_result: A 44 mm hood shades the modeled overhead ray while leaving 0.44 mm horizontal and 0.46 mm vertical sight margin.
physical_check: Measure screen offsets and actual bezel attachment lands. Where bezel is narrow, mock up external hook-and-loop tabs, then check connector and button access, touch gestures, fold clearance and glare.

engineering_result: Extending the apex travel gives 2.30 mm reserve at the large lens and 2.71 mm at the small lens.
physical_check: Check rod variation and binding, pad compression and slip, the selected lens’s static barrel band and the support bracket under lens load. Verify the bracket and clamp fasteners before attaching a camera.

product: Camera half cage for one body
engineering_result: Trimming the bottom plate keeps all three modeled access zones open, with 4.5 mm clearance at the closest door sweep.
physical_check: Measure the actual camera and three-dimensional motions, including the articulated display. Verify anti-twist features, connector insertion travel, fastener depth, door access and bracket retention before putting a camera in service.

engineering_result: Reducing carriage offset to 0.13 mm lowers modeled lens reversal play from 0.910° to 0.345° and retains 1.483 contact ratio.
physical_check: Measure chosen lens diameters and any gear installed, check print or cutter tolerance, run contact-blue and mesh-backlash checks at the tight and loose ends, and test focusing torque and marked repeatability without binding.

engineering_result: Raising and widening the front opening restores 3.20 mm of predicted clearance in the 24 mm full-frame bundle.
physical_check: Measure the chosen lens entrance pupil and its travel with zoom, focus and stabilization. On the real system verify edge illumination, flare, filter retention and the moved top flag at its full useful travel.

engineering_result: Doubling the optical channel to 18 mm narrows the predicted hard cutoff to 27.17° while leaving 64.42% clear frontal area.
physical_check: Measure the flash head and select heat-tolerant stock. Check plate registration, clip retention, peak temperature after repeated flashes and actual beam falloff on a target.

engineering_result: A 0.448 kg centered ballast increases the model's restoring-to-disturbance moment ratio from 1.26 to 2.92.
physical_check: Measure stand socket size and footprint, verify that ballast cannot shift, and check stable tipping and slip behavior against an actual tabletop draft before using it next to equipment.

engineering_result: A 24 mm effective brake contact radius supplies 1.79–5.25 N modeled paper tension and no more than 4.8 N estimated crank force.
physical_check: Measure chosen paper width, roll radius, bracket and table clamp range. Confirm breakaway and running friction with a spring scale, hand force, roll retention and wear after repeated cycles.

engineering_result: The layout increases bilingual fields to 4 mm nominal text size and adds 1.2 mm of nominal hinge clearance.
physical_check: Check actual font rendering and completed marks on the selected board stock. Check legibility at the planned camera distance, dry erase persistence, jaw rub, hinge strength and audio sync over 100 cycles.

engineering_result: Extending adjustable strap cut length to 500 mm keeps fitted strain between 4.4% and 14.2% across both chair routes.
physical_check: Fit the straps to the agreed chair, confirm the chair remains stable and move through fold cycles. Compare wrinkles and key quality under actual side lighting and check elastic creep.

engineering_result: A 170 × 132 mm beam splitter covers the modeled cue and camera-ray bundles and retains at least 3.47 mm at the tightest edge.
physical_check: Check the chosen phone case, mirror panel, coating, polarization, legibility, double images, matte-shroud flare and actual lens exit angle. Proof-load the selected camera and tray mounts during assembly validation.

engineering_result: Raising the spring anchor above the pivot reduces modeled residual torque from 1.20 to 0.394 N·m through the working range.
physical_check: Measure real center of mass and spring stroke, then proof and cycle the clamp, lock and pivot using an expendable load. Check release and cable clearance through the full arm articulation.

engineering_result: A 52 mm aperture radius and an 11 mm mesh gap preserve 12.28 mm of modeled source-cone clearance and 64 mm to the diaphragm.
physical_check: Compare recorded plosive peaks and in-band speech attenuation against recordings without a screen at identical gain. Check flex-neck range and clamp strength on the actual stand.

engineering_result: The softer cord setting reduces modeled 30 Hz motion transmission from 0.232 to 0.061 and retains 20.66 mm of static travel reserve.
physical_check: Check cord force-displacement with a spring scale, center the mic with cable attached, and measure impulse and sinusoidal transmission through the working orientation before making performance claims.

engineering_result: Increasing each wing to 163 mm raises the geometric rear coverage half-angle from 84.56° to 99.33°.
physical_check: Compare impulse records with and without the screen, inspect off-axis coloration and desk reflection, then verify hinge friction and stowed fit.

engineering_result: Matched wedges with a 24 mm height differential across 170 mm produce 8.04° tilt and at least 8 mm seating inset.
physical_check: Measure the actual speaker feet, load and center of mass. Verify foam compression, height matching, stability on the desk and transfer vibration at working volume.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Bound stereo balance at six settings with finite source and load impedances.
physical_check: Sweep both channels under a named load and measure tracking, residual hum, noise and mute isolation.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Sweep simultaneous dummy loads and reject a source with insufficient per-side peak current.
physical_check: Test both real outputs into declared dummy loads. Measure output limit, distortion, noise and heating; hearing comfort is outside the model.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Check all contact combinations, transition latency and loss of both closures.
physical_check: Verify dark state on unplug and time 100 mixer-contact transitions including simultaneous program and preview.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Replay light and hard strikes with coupled adjacent signals and compare false notes across two thresholds.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Exercise simultaneous holds and releases plus 500 strokes per pedal. Compare the reports with a one-key encoder.
physical_check: Run a hold and release log on each supported host. Measure debounce and verify shortcut behavior inside the intended app.

engineering_result: Manual coupler with 3.2 mm hook engagement and 0.355 mm geometry-only tip drift at 70 mm reach.
physical_check: On a catch mat, swap a 100 g dummy tool 100 times and measure static drift and retention after latching.

engineering_result: Two editable overlays for a synthetic 12-button board on a nominal ninth-generation iPad. A layout revision changed one opening. All 12 targets retain at least 1.419 mm modeled margin.
physical_check: Measure real mounting and display registration on the intended case and app. Test all target and gesture openings with the intended user. Time the fitting and any revisions.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Compare center and four edge activation forces for two hinge positions at a fixed switch lever distance.
physical_check: Measure activation force and travel at center and edges, inspect return, and test 500 actuations with the actual mounting and intended user.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Replay independent, simultaneous and reconfigured holds, including unplug recovery when a key is still down.
physical_check: Repeat on the two named hosts with the user's actual switches. Verify socket fit, accessibility and release handling.

engineering_result: Large-ball pointer housing and forty deterministic selection-and-drag scripts. A deadband change filters stationary jitter in all traces.
physical_check: Have an intended user select ten targets per quadrant and perform button-held drags. Measure errors, ball force and cleanup access.

engineering_result: Digital signal model. Interrupt a replacement message at each write-operation boundary and verify recovery of the prior committed audio payload.

Measure width variation over one metre and check blade retention after repeated adjustment.

engineering_result: Lift-out dye roller with 2–5 mm guide settings. The roller dips 2 mm, clears the tray floor by 6 mm, and lifts 2 mm above its lip.

Check bobbin compatibility, thread tension and repeatability of fill stop.

Check straightness against a reference surface and distinguish known high frets.

physical_check: Verify actual scale and fret centers at the neck, then measure straightness on a reference, recount contact lands and recheck stress relief and thermal distortion after machining.

engineering_result: Guided nut-and-saddle blank carrier and calibrated fence. The shortest abrasive travel across any blank point is 42 mm.

Measure radius along the beam and test finish without rocking.
Verify contact under a loaded neck with no dents or finish transfer.
Compare fine markings against known shims and check legibility under strings.
Test exit tear-out and mirrored positioning on scrap miters.

Verify center retention and diameter across minimum and maximum radius on scrap.
Check against a square unloaded and with normal clamping force.
Measure slip on clean and dusty surfaces and look for transfer marks on finish.
Check tool-rest clearance and collection with the customer's existing blower.
Test lateral and radial readings after reseating a known wheel.

Check the stated axle interfaces and movement under the intended service load.
Verify fit over supported widths without marring spokes.
Check the printed scale against calipers and the customer's actual shrink test bars.

Compare on known sample slabs and verify easy cleaning.

Verify retention, basket coverage and cleanup after repeated shots.

Check bar deflection, noise and cleanup after repeated knocks.
Check basket lip fit, particle trapping and cleanability on named baskets.
Verify range, heat exposure and repeated use without damaging original control.
